en: A black‑and‑white photograph shows a large medieval stone gate with multiple concentric, deeply recessed arches in Romanesque or early Gothic style. The masonry is rough and weathered, and above the arch is a simple sloped roof with tiles. Behind the gate is a tall wooden door made of vertical planks. Several children in dark 19th‑century style clothing stand in a line at the base of the arch, emphasizing its scale. The ground appears unpaved and there are bare trees visible through the opening. No visible printed caption or text appears on the image side.
